entries.reason: The phrases polynomial-bit locally computable potential and no rule can inspect or encode a global acceptance bit do not define a syntactic or semantic class. A finite local rewrite system can still simulate a work tape while decreasing a clock-like potential, and the statement gives no checkable criterion excluding that behavior. The exact formulation therefore does not close the circularity defect it was created to repair.
salvage: H106 replaces the undefined potential and channel prohibition by exactly q synchronous passes, radius-qr ancestry, and no persistent adaptive state.
